description: This file contains functions and logic related to transforming computational graphs for quantization-aware training and inference in PyTorch's FX framework, including shadowing, logging, and dtype casting of nodes within FX graphs.

methods.name: str|None _maybe_get_fqn(node: Node, gm: GraphModule)
methods.description: Retrieves the fully qualified name (FQN) of a FX Node within a GraphModule, accounting for special cases such as activation post-process modules.

methods.name: Node _insert_logger_after_node( node: Node, gm: GraphModule, logger_cls: Callable, logger_node_name_suffix: str, ref_node_name: str, model_name: str, ref_name: str, ref_node_target_type: str, results_type: str, index_within_arg: int, index_of_arg: int, fqn: str | None, )
methods.description: Inserts a logging node after a specified FX Node in the graph, used for monitoring tensor values during execution.

methods.name: GraphModule add_loggers_to_model( gm: GraphModule, node_to_instrument_inputs_to_ref_node_name: dict[Node, tuple[str, str]], node_to_instrument_outputs_to_ref_node_name: dict[Node, tuple[str, str]], logger_cls: Callable, model_name: str, )
methods.description: Augments a FX GraphModule by inserting loggers at specified nodes to monitor inputs and outputs, returning a new GraphModule with logging.

methods.name: Node _insert_quantize_per_tensor_node( prev_node_c: Node, node_a: Node, gm_b: GraphModule, graph_c: Graph, scale: torch.Tensor | float, zero_point: torch.Tensor | int, dtype_cast_name: str, )
methods.description: Creates a quantization node in the FX graph for per-tensor quantization with specified scale and zero point.

methods.name: Node|list[Node] _insert_dtype_cast_after_node( node_a: Node, node_c: Node, prev_node_c: Node | list[Node], gm_a: GraphModule, gm_b: GraphModule, graph_c: Graph, node_name_prefix: str, logger_cls: Callable, node_type_to_io_type_map: dict[str, set[NSNodeTargetType]], )
methods.description: Inserts the appropriate dtype casting node (e.g., dequantize or quantize) after a given FX node to convert between data types as needed.

methods.name: Node _copy_node_from_a_to_c( node_a: Node, gm_a: GraphModule, gm_b: GraphModule, graph_c: Graph, )
methods.description: Copies a node from one FX graph to another, handling get_attr and call_method nodes, used for recreating subgraphs.

methods.name: bool _can_insert_copy_of_subgraph_a( subgraph_a: NSSubgraph, gm_a: GraphModule, num_non_param_args_node_a: int, )
methods.description: Checks whether a subgraph of nodes can be safely copied into another graph, based on node types and special cases.

methods.name: Node _insert_copy_of_subgraph_a_after_input_node_c( input_node_c: Node | list[Node], input_node_c_2: Node | list[Node] | None, subgraph_a: NSSubgraph, gm_a: GraphModule, gm_b: GraphModule, node_name_prefix: str, )
methods.description: Inserts copies of a subgraph of nodes into a target graph, starting after a specified input node, used for subgraph cloning.

methods.name: Node _insert_copy_of_node_a_after_input_node_c( input_node_c: Node | list[Node], input_node_c_2: Node | list[Node] | None, node_a: Node, gm_a: GraphModule, gm_b: GraphModule, node_name_prefix: str, )
methods.description: Copies a specific node from one graph into another, preserving inputs and attributes, used within subgraph cloning.

methods.name: GraphModule create_a_shadows_b( name_a: str, gm_a: GraphModule, name_b: str, gm_b: GraphModule, matched_subgraph_pairs: dict[str, tuple[NSSubgraph, NSSubgraph]], logger_cls: Callable, should_log_inputs: bool, node_type_to_io_type_map: dict[str, set[NSNodeTargetType]] | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates a shadowed copy of one FX GraphModule over another, inserting dtype casts and loggers to enable mixed-precision introspection.
